result.quote: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law, but there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment.
result.reason: The key paraphrases part of verse 23:29, though “Jewish” is not explicit in the window. The broad question also permits other answers, such as that there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment, that a plot had been reported, or that the accusers were instructed to appear before Felix. In addition, “What did captain say in letter” is grammatically incomplete and does not specify which statement is sought; the window itself does not identify the speaker as a captain or explicitly call this a letter.
